name: File Server (Mail Drop)
author: SZMA Inform
description: Secure temporary file attachments for Bulwark Webmail with 28-day retention and PIN-code protection

serverUrl.label: File Server URL
serverUrl.description: Endpoint address of the corporate file server

apiKey.label: API Key (X-API-Key)
apiKey.description: Global secret key for authorized upload to the file server

sizeThresholdMb.label: Auto-intercept Size Threshold (MB)
sizeThresholdMb.description: Attachments larger than this size will trigger a prompt to upload to the file server

defaultTtlDays.label: Default Retention Period (days)
defaultTtlDays.description: File storage duration before automatic deletion (max 28)

alwaysAsk.label: Always Ask Confirmation
alwaysAsk.description: Show confirmation dialog before automatically uploading large attachments
